scenarios.title: Empty app
scenarios.description: A Vite app without QRCodeSDK. Includes the bundler runtime every app pays.

scenarios.title: Matrix
scenarios.description: Generates a QR code matrix from `@qrcodesdk/core/matrix`.

scenarios.title: Matrix from the root entry
scenarios.description: Imports `qrcode` from `@qrcodesdk/core`. Tree shaking should drop the renderers.

scenarios.title: Matrix with fixed mode, version, and mask
scenarios.description: Sets the mode, version, error correction, and mask explicitly.

scenarios.title: Automatic mode
scenarios.description: Selects the smallest single mode with `mode('auto')`.

scenarios.title: Kanji mode
scenarios.description: Adds the Shift JIS table from `@qrcodesdk/core/kanji`.

scenarios.title: QR, Micro QR, and rMQR
scenarios.description: All three symbol types in one bundle.

scenarios.title: PNG image element
scenarios.description: An image element backed by a PNG data URL.

scenarios.title: WEBP image element
scenarios.description: An image element backed by a WEBP data URL.

scenarios.title: GIF image element
scenarios.description: An image element backed by a GIF data URL.

scenarios.title: JPEG image element
scenarios.description: An image element backed by a JPEG data URL.

scenarios.title: All image formats
scenarios.description: PNG, WebP, GIF, and JPEG image renderers in one bundle.

scenarios.title: Everything from the browser root entry
scenarios.description: Uses every export of `@qrcodesdk/browser`. The upper bound for browser output.

scenarios.title: All built-in shapes
scenarios.description: Every built-in shape and pattern factory with colors.

scenarios.title: Custom shape
scenarios.description: SVG with a `customShape()` hexagon. Adds the path parser.

scenarios.title: Styled canvas
scenarios.description: Canvas with rounded modules and styled finder patterns.

scenarios.title: Lazy SVG renderer
scenarios.description: Generates the matrix up front and loads the SVG renderer on demand.
warnings: webpack adds 1.72 kB gzip over svg, Vite adds 1.04 kB

scenarios.title: Lazy image downloads
scenarios.description: Renders SVG up front and loads the PNG and JPEG renderers for a download menu.

scenarios.title: Lazy Micro QR and rMQR
scenarios.description: Renders a standard QR code up front and loads the Micro QR and rMQR encoders on demand.

scenarios.title: Two routes
scenarios.description: A router with a styled SVG route and a PNG route. Shows what the routes share and duplicate.

scenarios.title: Empty React app
scenarios.description: A React app without QRCodeSDK. The baseline of the React scenarios.

scenarios.title: Empty Vue app
scenarios.description: A Vue app without QRCodeSDK. The baseline of the Vue scenarios.

scenarios.title: Empty Svelte app
scenarios.description: A Svelte app without QRCodeSDK. The baseline of the Svelte scenarios.

scenarios.title: Empty Angular app
scenarios.description: A Angular app without QRCodeSDK. The baseline of the Angular scenarios.
